subject: angol
title: Where do we do our shopping?
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le a helyeket és az embereket, hasonlítsd össze a két vásárlási módot, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: It is a busy Saturday afternoon in a huge shopping centre. Three teenage girls are walking past bright shop windows with lots of shopping bags in their hands, and one of them is pointing at a big 'SALE – 50% OFF' sign. There are escalators, loud music and crowds of people everywhere. A tired father is sitting on a bench next to a pram with a sleeping baby in it.

An old woman is selling fresh vegetables, eggs and honey at an outdoor market in a small town. A young man with a cloth bag is buying tomatoes from her and paying in cash. The prices are written by hand on small pieces of cardboard. It is early morning, and people are chatting with each other between the stalls.

prompts: Describe the places and what the people are doing.
How is shopping different in the two places?
Where do you prefer to shop? Why?
followUpQuestions: How often do you go to a shopping centre? What do you do there?
Have you ever been to a market? What did you buy?
Do you buy things you don't really need when there is a sale?
Do you prefer shopping in shops or online? Why?
What do you do to save money?

usefulPhrases.en: They must have spent a lot of money.
Things are often cheaper in a sale.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The first picture shows a huge shopping centre on a busy Saturday afternoon. Three teenage girls are carrying lots of shopping bags, and one of them is pointing at a big sale sign. A tired father is sitting on a bench next to a pram. The second picture shows an outdoor market in a small town early in the morning. An old woman is selling vegetables, eggs and honey, and a young man is buying tomatoes and paying in cash. In both pictures people are shopping, but the atmosphere is very different. The shopping centre is crowded and noisy, while the market is calm and friendly, and the food there is fresh and local. Personally, I prefer markets. On Saturdays I often go to the market in Szombathely with my mum.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you buy things you don't really need when there is a sale?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Sometimes, yes. Last January I bought a jumper at half price, but I've only worn it once. Now I try to think twice before I buy something.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó leírja mindkét helyet és az embereket, kiemeli a közös pontot és a különbségeket, véleményt mond, és a rákérdezésre saját, őszinte tapasztalattal felel.
Szókincs: a vásárlás szavai a témához illők és változatosak (shopping centre, sale sign, pram, paying in cash, fresh and local, at half price).
Nyelvhelyesség: a képleírásban a folyamatos jelen, a tapasztalatnál a befejezett jelen (I've only worn it once) helyes, az ellentétet a „while” és a „but” köti össze.
Érdemes megtanulni: „In both pictures people are shopping, but the atmosphere is very different.”, „Personally, I prefer …”, „at half price”, „I try to think twice before I buy something”.
